prompt: our flywheel shooter behaves differently between matches for no reason — sometimes it's tuned right, sometimes way off, and we haven't changed anything. we've swapped the motor already. can you look at the code?

assertions.name: mutable-static-root-cause
assertions.text: The non-final public static (flywheelOffset) written in a lifecycle method is identified as a likely cause of the between-match inconsistency (cross-opmode state persistence), via failure_mode_lint's mutable_static check

assertions.name: not-blamed-on-hardware
assertions.text: Does not conclude the cause is hardware / accept the motor-swap as the fix; recognizes the 'behaves differently for no reason' symptom as the code-structure class this corpus catches

assertions.name: finding-is-authoritative
assertions.text: The static-state finding is presented as a concrete deterministic finding tied to the taxonomy, not a vague maybe
